claim: Complete exact rigid-bisection split census on the selected native published-R17-frame charts at the refreshed +10/+11/+12 fibres, with cover, section, anchor-parameterization, and displayed-quotient checks.
claim_boundary: Every listed extreme-anchored cover has generic Mordell-Weil rank at least 18, not a proved exact generic rank of 18.
Displayed jumps and remaining directions refer to certified independent displayed subgroups, not full Mordell-Weil rank upper bounds.
The finite-field sieve proves nonsquareness only when it stores a good-prime nonresidue; every survivor is decided over QQ.
Canonical heights are used only to propose relations; every retained relation is verified by exact elliptic-curve addition.
No Nagao score, residual-Selmer computation, or new rank-32 specialization search is performed by this certificate.

design_change.new_default: search only after selecting an exact rational bisection whose new section specializes nontrivially in a known extreme quotient
design_change.retired_default: continue the historical first-conic Nagao scan

rank_accounting.plus10_anchor: one nonzero anchored direction leaves at least nine displayed exceptional directions, so five further directions would reach 14
rank_accounting.plus11_anchor: one nonzero anchored direction leaves at least ten displayed exceptional directions, so four further directions would reach 14
rank_accounting.plus12_anchor: one nonzero anchored direction leaves at least eleven displayed exceptional directions, so three further directions would reach 14
rank_accounting.rank32_requirement_over_a_generic_rank_a: at most 14 further independent specialization directions

reproducing_command: run this script once with --chart 07ca9 and once with --chart 08234, then pass both outputs to --merge-completed-chart-payloads

required_features: exact QQ and rational-function elliptic-curve arithmetic
exact finite-field polynomial and square tests
PARI/GP height relations followed by exact group-law verification
